task.title: Money Flow Wedge Scout
task.objective: Discover the strongest tiny programmable software/AI intervention inside an existing large private-sector money flow, continuously rank a best surviving hypothesis, attack it when all build gates appear satisfied, and persist every run so future runs continue from accumulated evidence rather than restarting.

operating_protocol.discovery_floor: Every run must return at least one best surviving hypothesis even if some gates remain uncertain.
freeze_build_threshold: recurring measurable leakage or unrealized value
credible tiny fee stronger than obvious self-serve or flat-fee alternatives
no need to own the core transaction or request path
no dominant or sufficiently close incumbent or first-party feature
operating_protocol.search_behavior: Before threshold maintain a current leader and try to beat it. At threshold enter ATTACK and search for disconfirming evidence. If it survives, freeze and build; if it fails, record fatal flaw and promote the next candidate.
operating_protocol.persistence_rule: Every scheduled or manual run must append its normalized result, candidate scores, gate changes, evidence, rejected reasons, current leader and next research test to Taskman persistence before completion.

conversation_history.summary: Opportunity search narrowed away from tenders, jobs, freelance lead hunting, buyer/seller matchmaking, manufacturer sourcing and generic demand creation toward programmable interventions in existing private money flows.
Adopted eight strict build gates and lifecycle SEARCH -> ATTACK -> FROZEN-BUILD.
Rejected after attack because trigger was customer-created, intervention sat on the request path, first-party cheaper lanes and gateways existed, and performance pricing was weak.
Added two-level standard: every run must return a best surviving hypothesis while final build threshold stays strict; search breadth widened and now drills flow -> state transition -> micro-decision.
Clean authorization/fulfillment/expiry trigger, later weakened by first-party capture/reauthorization features and payment orchestration.
Strong minimum-spend shortfall economics, later weakened by cloud commitment managers and procurement/SaaS allocation tooling.
Excellent economics but current systems reconcile volume commitments, deficiency payments and make-up rights.
Promising pattern: two legitimate future uses already exist and a contractual or quota state changes which is economically optimal; detect before the decision and redirect existing activity.
Prepaid messaging credits plus scheduled sends created a good trigger; later search found mature multi-provider SMS routing/cost optimization layers.
GitHub/Taskman selected as permanent anchor for search state, evidence, rejected paths, scores, task results and conversation-derived knowledge.
Every recurring research run must read Taskman first and persist the full normalized result back to Taskman before completion.

Included/prepaid SaaS or API capacity approaches reset while already-planned deferrable workloads exist; clean trigger and measurable overage avoidance. Fresh research found the same quota/overage mechanism outside AI, including e-signature and security-scanning allowances, but one high-value vertical remains to be proven.

Provider-native app-store grace windows create a real net-margin choice for high-variable-cost apps, but the decision is app-wide/infrequent, relatively spreadsheetable and difficult to attribute for performance pricing.

Refund-promise to settlement matching remains attractive, but fresh enterprise reconciliation products already surface missing refunds across gateway/ERP/bank data and the aggregate leakage pool remains unquantified.
Exact tools already identify unused labels and automate carrier refunds/voids, including performance-priced recovery.

conversation_history.candidate: Prior-authorization expiry before scheduled service watchdog
conversation_history.summary: Current authorization tools already track expiry and explicitly flag authorizations that will expire before scheduled procedures.

Excess corporate earnings credits can expire monthly and create material idle-cash losses, but DebtBook explicitly optimizes balances to avoid excess zero-interest cash, bank-fee platforms ingest machine-readable account-analysis files, and banks provide target-balance sweeps/hybrid interest accounts.
Refundable auto-parts core deposits have strong deadlines and measurable leakage, but dedicated tools and repair-shop software already track deposits, deadlines, returns and credits.
Booking and cancellation deadlines are machine-readable, but current corporate travel software already auto-cancels bookings/trips to avoid no-show fees and lost value.

conversation_history.candidate: Vendor credit memo application before payment
conversation_history.summary: ERP/AP tools already track unapplied vendor credits and surface or automatically apply them in payment runs.

Fresh quota evidence outside AI confirms the mechanism is broader: annual e-signature envelope allowances and monthly security/SaaS usage quotas can create overage/reset boundaries. The remaining challenge is finding one vertical with meaningful movable workload and enough leakage to support a tollbooth.

current_leader.name: Quota-boundary workload timing optimizer
current_leader.state_transition: included or prepaid quota plus reset/expiry boundary -> already-planned non-urgent work exists -> executing on the wrong side of the boundary causes overage or destroys paid allowance -> recommend safe timing/reassignment -> verified incremental spend avoided
current_leader.why_survived: Fresh research found the same objective quota/overage structure across non-AI SaaS categories, including annual e-signature envelope allowances and monthly security-scanning or API allowances. Billing/usage state exists independently, a read-only sidecar can recommend timing rather than proxy requests, and the avoided overage is measurable. No dominant general buyer-side quota-boundary scheduler was found.
strongest_evidence: Current SaaS products expose non-rollover allowances plus explicit overage prices, creating real financial reset boundaries.
Docusign terms define annual envelope allowances and per-envelope overage charges, confirming the mechanism outside AI inference.
Security-scanning products expose included monthly scans plus per-scan overage, another non-AI example.
Usage dashboards and billing APIs/exports make quota state machine-readable without customer-created labels.
current_leader.closest_threat: The mechanism may remain too heterogeneous, and individual SaaS platforms expose first-party budgets/usage dashboards. It fails if safe workload timing is uncommon or if useful intervention requires becoming an inline request router.
current_leader.smallest_intervention: Read usage/billing APIs or exports plus an existing job queue/calendar; compute remaining allowance, reset/expiry time, overage price and job deadlines; recommend RUN BEFORE RESET, DEFER UNTIL RESET, or USE EXISTING ALLOWANCE. No proxy or payment execution initially.
current_leader.monetization: Small per-success fee or capped percentage of objectively avoided overage/forfeited allowance.
current_leader.biggest_unresolved_risk: Need one sufficiently large non-AI vertical with high per-customer leakage, machine-readable work deadlines and enough safe timing flexibility to support repeated savings without request-path ownership.
current_leader.next_research_test: Narrow the quota-boundary mechanism to enterprise e-signature envelopes, security scanning, communications and other non-AI metered SaaS. Quantify overage economics and test whether workflow systems already schedule work against quota boundaries. Promote only a vertical where queue/deadline data is available and savings recur at meaningful scale.

runner_ups.reason: Excellent attribution and non-invasive recovery, but closer reconciliation competition and still-unproven leakage magnitude.
Real economic tradeoff but infrequent/app-wide and hard to performance-price.
Real expiry but routing incumbents can absorb expiry awareness.

new_search_rules: A large visible leak is not enough if a first-party sweep, target-balance feature or adjacent treasury module already makes the optimal action routine.
Quota-boundary opportunities are stronger when both the financial unit and work unit are independently machine-readable and the action is timing rather than routing through our infrastructure.
Before promoting a refundable-deposit or deadline candidate, search vertical operational software because niche industries often already have exact tracking products.
Treat products that already ingest both operational and bank data as stronger Gate-8 threats to cross-system reconciliation wedges even when they stop short of performance-priced recovery.

known_rejected_or_demoted: expiring contractual financial entitlements broad family
bank guarantee or standby-LC cash-margin release monitoring
unused corporate airline ticket value recovery
prior-authorization expiry before scheduled service watchdog
vendor credit memo application before payment
